clock = game.clock
hist = getattr(self, 'perf_hist', None)
if hist is None:
    hist = []
    self.perf_hist = hist
hist.append(clock.get_rawtime())
del hist[:-30]
ms = sum(hist) / len(hist)
z = getattr(self, 'raycast_floor_z', 0) or 0
self.perf_text = '%.1f ms/image   %d i/s   hauteur %d px' % (ms, clock.get_fps(), z)
